paper.title: Algorithm 689: COLVI2, nonlinear Volterra integral equations of the second kind

stack: Fortran 77 (netlib TOMS/ACM 689.gz: one text file, FILE_1..FILE_12 in its header, driver PASS 1-12)

claim.text: PASS 1 of the shipped test program (DEFOPT=21, REQTOL=1e-3, fixed step 1.0 on the 50-step problem): GLOB.ERR. for the first component at t = 50, as printed by the driver: -.1165398569E-06. Tolerance 1e-9 absolute, fixed before any run (queue entry). Claim is the GLOB.ERR. value only; the count fields are not claimed.

reference.note: sha256 of the extracted shipped PASS 1 block (evidence/shipped-reference.txt). The queue entry's 048cd1e... is the sha of the decompressed text, 689.txt.

attempt: Original attempt (G1): the archive as shipped is one text file with no build file. gfortran 16.2.0 refuses to compile it (header text, duplicate DECLUF/SOLLUF/ZERPOL in FILE_7 and FILE_8, two NCPJOB versions, two DRIVER programs). Then the selected file (689.txt minus header, CYBER NCPJOB, IMSL block and drivers 2-12; no other line changed) with MACHAR as shipped: gfortran reports 'passed REAL(4) to INTEGER(4)' for EPS, EPSNEG, XMIN, XMAX, because MACHAR's REAL declaration is on a CS-marked line that the archive says to change. Log: evidence/g1-unmodified-machar-attempt.log. Patches (all before the build, none in the build step): (1) CS marker blanked and CD lines commented in MACHAR, the archive's own instruction; (2) impl/etime_shim.f, written for this rerun, supplies the external ETIME (CPU-time limit only) from CPU_TIME; (3) for the second pass only, -fdefault-real-8. Pass 1 (default REAL = 4 bytes, the build's default): GLOB.ERR. = -1.147389412e-06, which is 9.8e-07 from the claim, outside the 1e-9 tolerance. Pass 2 (-fdefault-real-8): GLOB.ERR. = -1.165395988e-07, 2.6e-13 from the claim, inside. Pass 2 was chosen after pass 1 missed, so it is not a registered pass; see the blocked cause.

original_attempt.reason: The archive as shipped is one file with no build file, and gfortran refuses to compile it (see the attempt text).
